study: issue 120 revision check: candidates, bar, selection and call plan

derivation.step: less the pages whose frontmatter has superseded_by
live pages with a changed source
less the entry absent at its sha

structural_rules.rule: A page whose frontmatter carries superseded_by is skipped.
A source whose path is missing at the matched repository's HEAD gets no revision kind.
A source whose path is missing at its sha goes to the exact kind and gets no revision kind.

changed_lines.lines: the + and - lines of the hunks
changed_lines.excluded: file headers (diff, index, ---, +++) and hunk headers (@@)

anchors.extraction: wiki_studio.fact_diff, unchanged: _BACKTICK_RE spans normalized by _normalize_identifier, and _PATH_LINE_RE references as <file>:<line>, both over the page body with fenced code blanked by _without_fences
anchors.match: the anchor occurs as a substring of a changed line

heading_rule.applies_to: a source whose path ends in .md
heading_rule.heading: the nearest ATX heading at or above the hunk's first old-side line, in the source at the cited sha
heading_rule.pure_insertion: the old-side line the insertion follows
heading_rule.match: the heading's text occurs in the page body, case-insensitive
heading_rule.no_heading_above: the heading rule does not fire for that hunk

revisit_when.line: the first body line outside fenced code whose text, after leading whitespace and an optional list marker, starts with the prefix; read to the end of that line
revisit_when.tokens: wiki_studio.wiki_state._tokenise, which drops its stop list
revisit_when.match: a changed line shares at least one token with the line's text after the prefix
revisit_when.not_recorded: a page with no such line, or whose line contains "not recorded" (case-insensitive), has no Revisit-when tokens

candidates.name: plain change
candidates.flags_when: the path differs between the sha and HEAD

candidates.name: change ignoring whitespace
candidates.flags_when: the path differs between the sha and HEAD under -w --ignore-blank-lines

candidates.name: anchor touch
candidates.flags_when: a changed line contains one of the page's anchors, or the heading rule fires for a hunk

candidates.name: Revisit-when tokens
candidates.flags_when: a changed line shares a token with the page's Revisit when: line

fallback.when: the page has no Revisit-when tokens

candidates.name: anchor touch and Revisit-when tokens
candidates.flags_when: C2 and C3 both flag the source, each with its own fallback

recall.counts: cases with should_flag true and negative false

reported_only.what: cases with should_flag false and negative false; for each candidate, whether it flags each case

selection: among the candidates that pass the bar, the fewest false pages flagged
then the fewest git processes on the study run

p2.per: repository, once, when p1 succeeds and the repository is not shallow

p3.per: distinct sha, repository by repository in order until the first match or ambiguity

p5.per: changed cited path, only as a candidate needs it (C1 and the C1 fallbacks)

p6.per: changed cited path, only as a candidate needs it (C2, C3, C4)

p7.per: changed cited Markdown path, only as a candidate needs it (the heading rule of C2 and C4)

cut_1.trigger: the end of week 2 passes without the freeze, invoked by the owner at the milestone
cut_1.effect: candidates narrow to C0, C1 and C2; C3 and C4 are named as unmeasured
